name: Agents24x7 – AI Helper for Your Site: write SEO posts, grow traffic
author: Agents24x7

sections.description:
TL;DR ⚡
– Quick setup → start in under 2 minutes
– Chat to create → posts, pages, product copy
– Works 24/7 → schedules, recurring tasks, weekly reports
– WooCommerce ready → products, orders, inventory summaries

Meet Agents24x7 — like hiring a smart teammate who never sleeps, never forgets, and loves repetitive tasks.
Type what you need, and your assistant handles the rest. Short, clear replies. No jargon. 🚀

Think of it as an AI writer for WordPress—an AI blog post generator and WooCommerce AI product description helper that can schedule posts automatically, with a ChatGPT-style assistant inside your dashboard.

Why You’ll Love It 💙

  • Super Simple Setup: Install → Hire → Chat. That’s it.
  • Write More, Faster: Blog posts, pages, headlines, descriptions — in your voice.
  • SEO-savvy: Suggests topics, outlines, and on-page improvements.
  • Pro-level blog posts: Clean structure, clear headings, and meta ideas that help posts score high on SEO.
  • Beautiful images, built-in 🖼️: Auto-generate eye-catching post images so your articles look polished and professional.
  • Smart internal linking 🔗: Suggests relevant links to your existing posts (you approve) — great for SEO & organic traffic.
  • WooCommerce Support: Summaries, product copy, inventory updates.
  • Built-in Memory: “Use a friendly tone.” “No jargon.” It remembers.
  • Scheduling Magic: “Every Tuesday 3pm, draft a post.” “Mondays: send order report.”
  • Secure by Design: Uses WordPress Application Passwords + industry-standard encryption.

Key Features ✅

  • Chat to create: Blog posts, pages, and product copy—fast.
  • WooCommerce savvy: Product descriptions + weekly order summaries.
  • Set & forget: Recurring tasks and scheduled drafts.
  • Remembers your rules: Tone, words to avoid, structure.
  • Review first: Draft-only mode until you approve.
  • Post images included: Generate featured images/illustrations for a pro look.
  • Safe & secure: Uses WordPress Application Passwords.
  • 3-click setup: Install → Hire → Chat.
  • Bonus: “Continue to Telegram” handoff for on-the-go replies.

What Makes Agents24x7 Different 🌟

  • Scheduling-first: Tell it once—get content every week on autopilot.
  • WooCommerce built-in: Summaries + product copy without extra add-ons.
  • Real memory: It follows your style and house rules automatically — teach it your preferences and it will remember.
  • Channel handoff: Continue the conversation via Telegram when you leave WP.

What It Can Do 🧠

  • Content Creation:
    • Write/blog on any topic
    • Generate outlines, ideas, and summaries
    • Draft pages (About, Services, FAQs)
    • Create featured images/illustrations for posts and pages
  • Research & Planning:
    • Find trending topics
    • Quick summaries for complex topics
    • Competitor content scan (high-level)
  • WooCommerce:
    • Draft/optimize product descriptions
    • Weekly order summaries by email/chat
    • Light inventory notes (e.g., “running low”)
  • Scheduling & Automation:
    • Recurring tasks (“Fridays: post idea list”)
    • Auto-draft content on a schedule
    • Reminder pings so nothing slips
  • Conversation Superpowers:
    • Chat naturally in English, Hebrew, and more
    • Remembers your preferences
    • Clear, short answers by default

Try These Prompts (Copy & Paste) 💬

  • “Draft a post about {topic} in a friendly, practical tone. End with 3 actionable tips.”
  • “Outline a 5-section blog on {keyword}. Include this YouTube tutorial link: {YouTube URL}.”
  • “Write a WooCommerce product description for {product}. Focus on benefits, then specs.”
  • “Every Friday 18:00, draft a post about {category}. Save as Draft.”
  • “Summarize this URL in 5 bullets and suggest an SEO title: {link}”
  • “Rewrite this paragraph to be clearer and shorter: {paste text}”
  • “Create 10 blog ideas for {niche}. Include a 1-line angle for each.”
  • “Send me a Monday 09:00 summary of orders from Fri–Sun.”

Designed for Real Life 👇

  • Bloggers & Creators: Post consistently without burnout.
  • Small Businesses: Delegate repetitive website tasks.
  • WooCommerce Stores: Faster product pages, clearer reports.
  • Busy People: Get more done while you sleep.

Real Wins (True Stories) 🏆

  • “Write about chairs every Friday. Got more people in the site and increased my sales.” → Wakes up Saturday to a fresh, SEO-ready post.
  • “Monday report of weekend orders.” → Clear email with what sold + trends.
  • “Help with candle collection descriptions.” → On-brand copy that converts.

Safety & Privacy 🔒

  • Uses WordPress Application Passwords (keeps your main login safe)
  • Assistant can create/edit content and work with WooCommerce data you allow
  • It cannot: change settings, install plugins, access payment data, or touch your personal files

Social Channels, Documentation & Support

  • ✅ Contact Support Team: Email us
  • 🌐 Like us on Facebook: Agents24x7 on Facebook
  • ▶️ Watch the Tutorial Video: YouTube Tutorial
  • 𝕏 Follow us on X: @Agents24x7
  • 💼 Connect on LinkedIn: Agents24x7
  • 📸 Follow us on Instagram: @agents24x7
  • 📺 Subscribe to our YouTube Channel: Agents24x7 on YouTube
  • ⭐ Rate Agents24x7 on WordPress: WordPress.org Plugin Page

Time to Get Started with Agents24x7 🎯

Agents24x7 runs on a multi-model engine: OpenAI, Gemini, Claude (and more). The models review each other’s work and refine drafts, so you get stronger results with fewer AI mistakes.

What this means for you:
– Clearer, more accurate drafts
– Smarter SEO ideas (titles, headings, internal links)
– Consistent publishing that compounds over time

Real-world impact users report:
– Significant organic traffic growth
– More leads and higher sales
– A steady stream of new ideas and fresh angles for products & categories

Anyone can write a great post once in a while. Agents24x7 makes it consistent — week after week.

Privacy

This plugin connects to external services to provide functionality:
* Agents24x7 Service – AI assistant features

We keep data collection minimal and use industry-standard security. No personal payment data is stored by this plugin. Review the service privacy policies to learn more.

User Testimonials

“I was skeptical at first, but this actually works! My assistant wrote three great blog posts this week while I focused on running my business.” – Sarah M.

“Setup was so easy my 15-year-old could do it. Now I have fresh content ideas every day.” – Mike R.

“My WooCommerce store runs so much smoother now. I get weekly order reports and my assistant even writes product descriptions that actually sell!” – David K.

“I told my assistant once to ‘never use industry jargon’ and it remembers every single time. It’s like having a team member who never forgets.” – Jennifer L.

Pro Tips (Optional)

  • Start simple: “Write a post about {topic} in a friendly tone.”
  • Save favorite prompts for repeat tasks.
  • Use scheduling for consistency and 24/7 work.
  • Give short feedback — it learns fast.
sections.installation:
Quick Start (3 steps) ⏱️
1. Click Install Now → Activate
2. Go to Agents24x7 from the wordpress menu on the left
3. Complete the setup wizard (create account & hire)

Alternative: Upload the ZIP
1. Download the latest ZIP from the WordPress.org page: Agents24x7 Plugin
2. In your WordPress dashboard go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
3. Choose file (the ZIP) → Install Now → Activate

Manual (FTP/SFTP) Install
1. Download the ZIP and unzip it
2. Upload the folder agents24x7 to /wp-content/plugins/
3. Go to Plugins and Activate “Agents24x7”

After activation, open Agents24x7 from the menu on the left and finish the setup wizard.

You’re in! Next 2 minutes 🧭
– Pick your assistant’s name + avatar
– Wait for the agent to onboard, learn your site, competitors analysis and keyword research (~2-3 minutes)
– Try: “Write a post about healthy breakfasts.”
sections.faq:
Will it publish automatically?

Only if you ask. Keep Draft-only on while you review, then switch to auto-publish when ready.

Can I review content before it goes live?

Yes. By default, your assistant saves drafts for your approval. You’re always in control.

Is it really just 3 clicks to set up?

Yes. Install plugin → Create account → Start chatting. No complex settings.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The assistant runs securely in the cloud and keeps your site fast.

Can I control what gets published?

Absolutely. Set Draft-only until you approve. You’re always in control.

What if I don’t like what it writes?

Say “Try again” or “Shorter/More playful/More expert.” It learns your preferences.

Is my website secure?

Yes. We use built-in WordPress security and application passwords. Your main login is never stored.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Get order summaries, product copy, and light inventory notes out of the box.

Can I schedule recurring tasks?

Yes. Examples: “Every Tuesday 3pm, draft a post.” “Mondays 9am, send order report.”

Does it remember my style?

Yes. Tell it once: tone, words to avoid, structure — it remembers.

Do I need technical skills?

Nope. If you can send a message, you can use Agents24x7.

Is there a free trial?

Yes — You get 100 credits for free. No credit card required.
